arguments.name: object
arguments.text: Plain vector or array. It is wrapped as a zoo series and the core data is returned.

arguments.name: fill
arguments.text: Left, interior, and right fill values. "extend" repeats an end or interpolates the interior.

arguments.name: ix
arguments.text: Positions to keep. Defaults to the non-missing entries.

origin.details: The default method calls the zoo method and returns its core data.
origin.value: Numeric filled values. c(1, NA, 3, NA, NA) with "extend" returns 1, 2, 3, 3, 3.
origin.example:
.libPaths(c(path.expand("~/R/library"), .libPaths()))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(zoo))
stopifnot(packageVersion("zoo") == "1.9-1")
x <- na.fill.default(c(1, NA, 3, NA, NA), "extend")
cat(paste(vapply(as.numeric(x), function(v) if (is.nan(v)) "NaN" else if (is.na(v)) "NA" else sprintf("%.12g", v), ""), collapse = " "), "\n", sep = "")
